units.source_text: 前天晚上，暖香园对局室换上了新榻榻米。

en.t: The night before last, the game room at Dankoen had been fitted with new tatami mats.

units.source_text: 十一月十八日早晨，踏入这房间，还嗅到飘溢出一股新榻榻米的气味，

en.t: On the morning of November eighteenth, when one stepped into the room, the scent of the new tatami still drifted through the air,

units.source_text: 小杉四段从奈良屋搬来了在箱根使用过的名棋盘。

en.t: and Kosugi, fourth dan, brought over from Naraya the famous go board that had been used at Hakone.

units.source_text: 名人和大竹七段就座后，一打开棋盒盖子，黑子便漾出一股夏天的霉味。

en.t: After the Master and Otake, seventh dan, took their seats, the moment the lid of the stone bowl was opened, a summer mildew smell rose from the black stones.

units.source_text: 他们让旅馆的掌柜和女佣来帮忙，当场把霉菌拂去。

en.t: They had the innkeeper and a maid help them, and brushed the mold away on the spot.
